title: Interview frame
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 15 (Interview frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 15: Bridge: about me: asking and answering questions. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Answers
points: أَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ (I live in London)

parts.text: كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟ عُمْرِي ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً.
Report: اِسْمُهُ بِلَالٌ، وَهُوَ يَسْكُنُ فِي بِرْمِنْغْهَام.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Questions, answers, then a report with هُوَ
The question uses تَسْكُنُ (you live). Answer with أَسْكُنُ (I live). Add فِي and the place.

questions.q: Core: Write your answers to the four key questions in full sentences (portal response box).
questions.a: For example: اِسْمِي يُوسُفُ. عُمْرِي ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً. أَسْكُنُ فِي لِيسْتَر. أَنَا مِنْ بِرِيطَانِيَا.

questions.q: Extend: In a breakout pair, interview your partner and write a three-line report with هُوَ / هِيَ.
questions.a: For example: اِسْمُهَا مَرْيَمُ. عُمْرُهَا اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً. هِيَ تَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَنَ.

questions.q: Stretch: Translate into Arabic: My name is Adam. I am 13 and I live in Leeds.
questions.a: اِسْمِي آدَمُ. عُمْرِي ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً وَأَسْكُنُ فِي لِيدْز.

questions.q: 'Where do you live?' to a girl is:
questions.a: B) أَيْنَ تَسْكُنِينَ؟. For 'you' feminine the present verb ends in ـِينَ: تَسْكُنِينَ.

questions.q: What does أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟ ask? A) where you live B) your age C) your name
Big question: write the three questions that tell you most about someone.
questions.a: مَا اسْمُكَ؟ كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟ أَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ؟
